assessments.reasoning: Sections 6.7.5 and 6.7.9 expressly condition OpenCL C 3.0 generic pointers on the feature and distinguish allowed named-to-generic assignments from constant.

challenge.method: Read physical pages 46 and 53 together. Compare example assignments, the reverse direction requiring a cast, and the feature precondition.
challenge.results: Global, local and private pointers can be assigned to corresponding unnamed-generic pointers without an explicit cast. Constant is expressly excluded and the reverse direction has a separate rule.

limitations: This applies to corresponding pointers under the v3.0.19 language rules and the stated OpenCL C 3.0 feature condition. Actual device support was not tested.
